chair.description: Used in dining rooms or offices, a chair has a raised seat, vertical backrest, and four legs, sometimes with armrests, characterized by its ergonomic support for single-person seating.

cabinet.description: Typically mounted on walls or standing in kitchens/bathrooms, featuring rectangular structures with doors, shelves, or drawers, identifiable by its enclosed storage and hinges/knobs.

plant.description: Typically displayed indoors near windows or corners, features leafy green foliage or vibrant flowers in varied colors, often potted in decorative containers either placed on floors/shelves or hung in elevated positions like baskets, distinguished by its organic forms and lively hues contrasting with man-made interiors.

sofa.description: Found in living areas, a sofa is a long upholstered seat, typically rectangular rather than square in shape, with padded armrests and a high backrest, distinguished by its cushioned seating for multiple people and fabric or leather exterior.

bed.description: Commonly positioned in bedrooms, features a rectangular frame with a mattress topped by bedding such as quilts and pillows, characterized by its standardized length and width designed for horizontal sleeping and its elevated structure above the floor.

chest_of_drawers.description: Usually found in bedrooms or closets, structured as a vertical, multi-tiered unit with stacked horizontal drawers, recognized by its handles/knobs and rectangular, waist-high frame.

television.description: Commonly positioned in living rooms or bedrooms, a television features a large rectangular screen framed by a slim border, often mounted on a wall or stand.

counter.description: Usually seen in kitchens or stores, is a long, flat surface often built on top of cabinets or fixtures, and is distinguished by its extended length and use for tasks like preparing food or serving customers.
